Когда выбирать AI, а когда — классически: When to choose AI and when to go classic
AI-инструменты закрывают задачи, где важ: AI tools handle tasks where speed and volume matter: a stream of similar requests, product content for social media and marketplaces, first-pass lead qualification. Where emotion, brand trust or one-off craft decides, we'll suggest whatever works better — even if it isn't AI. We're a full-cycle production house, not just an AI contractor, so we don't bend the task to fit the tool.
Как мы работаем с AI-инструментами: How we work with AI tools
Начинаем не с внедрения технологии, а с: We don't start with deploying technology; we start with an audit of the process: sales, content or client communication. We find 1–2 bottlenecks where the effect will be measurable and launch the pilot right there — not across the whole funnel at once. If the pilot shows results, we expand to other processes; if not, we say so plainly and change the approach. We sign an NDA before any internal data is shared.
AI-направление растёт внутри сервиса с п: Our AI practice grows inside a service with full-cycle video production and a production culture — 8 years on the market, 350+ clients, about 60% of orders from repeat clients.
